{"code": "### Step: Handle sentinel value -999 in biomarker_baseline
# The data dictionary says: -999 is a QC failure code, not a measurement.
# So we must exclude these rows from any calculation of mean baseline biomarker.

# Count how many severe patients have -999 in biomarker_baseline
severe_with_sentinel = severe_dedup[severe_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print(f"Number of severe patients with sentinel value (-999) in baseline: {severe_with_sentinel.shape[0]}")

# Filter out those rows
severe_clean = severe_dedup[severe_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
print(f"Number of severe patients with valid baseline biomarker: {severe_clean.shape[0]}")

# Check: are there any valid values left?
assert severe_clean.shape[0] > 0, "No valid baseline values for severe patients after removing -999""}
